blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feature reconstruction is widely used for unsupervised industrial anomaly detection in the single-class setting, where only normal images from one product category are available for training. We propose a single-class detector that asks what information one block can pass to another. We treat the depth of a frozen vision transformer as a sequence of discrete transitions. A directed predictor learns a block-to-block hidden-state transition pointwise over tokens. Adjacent-layer cosine similarity exposes four sharp fault lines in DINOv2 ViT-L, separating stable depth segments. The deepest blocks retain semantic context but lose local detail; a prediction from deep or shallow sources to sensitive targets therefore exposes the information that cannot be transported. The fault structure fixes the source and target roles, and the same rule transfers to ViT-B and RADIO-B. We use a bounded foreground prior calibrated solely on training images: it attenuates background evidence without also erasing defects outside the estimated foreground. Using one predictor architecture and a common training-only calibration protocol, image AUROC is 99.75 on MVTec-AD, 99.42 on VisA and 94.27 on Real-IAD. On Real-IAD the object-level AUROC is 96.26. At 256x256 pixel resolution, P-AUROC/P-AUPRO are 98.46/95.97 on MVTec-AD, 99.21/96.12 on VisA and 99.26/96.59 on Real-IAD.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Industrial inspection must detect defects that cannot be enumerated in advance. We consider the
single-class setting, where training uses only normal images from one product category.
MVTec-AD [ 3 ] , VisA [ 42 ] and
Real-IAD [ 36 ] follow this protocol. The leading methods reconstruct features
from a frozen encoder [ 11 , 17 , 16 ] . A bottleneck
compresses the features, a decoder reconstructs selected teacher features, and anomalies appear as
large residuals. Fig. 1 motivates a different design: the deepest features remain insensitive to local defects,
while an asymmetric cross-layer predictor tests whether deep and shallow sources can transport
the missing evidence to sensitive blocks; the transfer failure becomes the anomaly signal.

reproduce, which permits a copying shortcut. Second, the target representations are selected by
architectural convention. RD4AD [ 11 ] reconstructs multi-scale encoder
representations through a one-class bottleneck, whereas the Dinomaly
line [ 17 , 16 ] reconstructs a fixed group of ViT blocks.
Neither choice is tied to a measured property of the representation, and sensitive and insensitive
layers are treated alike.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reconstruction and distillation. RD4AD [ 11 ] reconstructs multi-scale
frozen encoder representations through a one-class bottleneck. The Dinomaly
line [ 17 , 16 ] reconstructs a selected group of ViT blocks.
DeSTSeg [ 41 ] adds segmentation-guided denoising, while unified models alter
their architecture, bottleneck, objective or aggregation [ 38 , 15 , 40 , 19 ] . These methods condition the decoder on the features it reconstructs and choose the
target representations by convention. Our predictor maps one layer to a different layer, and the
measured fault structure defines the source and target roles.

bidirectional fail-safe, assuming that the selected inter-layer transition is invertible. Our

identifies block 1 1 as the first stable shallow source, while participation collapses across the
final segment after 21 | 22 21|22 , with further compression at 22 | 23 22|23 . The deepest blocks therefore no
longer carry the fine local evidence needed to predict sensitive targets faithfully. We use both
shallow and deep blocks as sources and sensitive blocks as targets. The fault structure determines
these roles rather than benchmark ablation: L7 is the last sensitive block before the 7 | 8 7|8 fault,
L14 is the midpoint of [ 8..21 ] [8..21] with a participation-ratio tie-break, and block 0 0 is not used as
a production endpoint. Forward and backward predictors remain distinct directed channels rather
than being collapsed into a single symmetric bidirectional fail-safe design.

blocks.en:
Cost and operating regime. The backbone runs once and only the directed predictors and
foreground probes are trained. The eight predictors share the same token dimension and hidden
width, so inference consists of eight token-wise MLPs after one six-layer feature read. No test
image updates the model, and no channel is selected from test performance. We do not claim an
end-to-end efficiency ranking: wall-clock latency and peak memory were not measured under a
controlled hardware protocol. SAM-2 is needed only to build training pseudo-masks. When masks are
unavailable, the prior is disabled as a degraded fallback: removing it lowers image AUROC by 0.14 0.14 , 1.05 1.05 and 3.71 3.71 pp on cable, pcb1 and macaroni2, respectively.
blocks.zh:
成本和运作制度。 骨干运行一次 并且只有定向预测器和
前景探测器已经训练完毕。 八个预测器都一样的尺寸和隐藏
宽度,因此推论由一个六层功能读取后由八个以符号为主的MLP组成. 没有测试
图像更新模型,没有从测试性能中选择频道. 我们不声称
端到端效率排名:没有在a下测量墙上时空和峰值内存
控制硬件协议。 只需要SAM-2来建造训练用伪相. 当面具是
无法使用,前身作为已退化回落物被禁用:移除后将AUROC的图像分别降低于有线、pcb1和通心粉2上的0.14.0.14、1.05.1.05和3.71 3.71页。

blocks.en:
The mixed comparison with Dinomaly2 is useful for deployment choices. Our gains are largest at the
image level on Real-IAD and VisA, while Dinomaly2 remains stronger in pixel ranking and on the
nearly saturated MVTec-AD benchmark. Applications that need to decide whether a part is abnormal
can therefore use the image-level score; pixel localization remains the weaker side of our method.
blocks.zh:
与Dinomaly2的混合比较对部署选择有用。 我们的成果最大
Real-IAD 和 VisA 上的图像级别,而 Dinomaly2 在像素排名和在
几乎饱和的MVTec-AD基准. 需要确定某一部分是否不正常的应用程序
因此可以使用图像级别分数;像素本地化仍然是我们方法的较弱一面.

blocks.en:
The main failure modes are also visible from the design. Multi-object scenes lose the global
branch because its mean mixes unrelated objects. Thin objects can produce incomplete SAM-2 masks,
which is why the reliability gate disables the prior when geometry or foreground/background
contrast is implausible. Finally, the method assumes that a category has a stable normal training
set; cross-category training would require recalibrating the background prior and the target-depth
statistics.
blocks.zh:
主要故障模式也从设计中可见. 多对象场景失去全局
分支,因为它的平均值混合了无关的对象。 薄的物体可以产生不完整的SAM-2口罩,
这就是为什么在几何或前地/后地时可靠性门会禁用前地
对比是不可思议的。 最后,该方法假定一个类别有稳定的正常训练。
;跨类别培训需要重新校正背景和深入的目标
统计。

blocks.en: 4.5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The fixed eight-channel set avoids label-dependent channel search and combines 1 → 14 1{\to}14 reconfiguration, L7 fine structure and deep-to-L14 regional deviations. Using one or two deep
sources instead of three costs 0.29 0.29 and 0.10 0.10 pp, while leaving the sensitive segment costs over 5 5 pp. Target depth therefore matters more than source identity, which mainly provides a
robustness margin. Branch A corrects a per-image offset, and branch B removes a smooth spatial
background. The global branch captures whole-part shifts but cannot localise, so it is excluded
from the pixel metric; pixel scoring averages the eight residual maps directly.
blocks.zh:
固定的八道套能避免依赖标签的频道搜索,并结合了1~14 1~to}14重整,L7精细结构以及深到L14的区域偏差. 用一两个深
将敏感部分的费用留到5页以上。 因此,目标深度比源身份更重要,因为源身份主要提供
坚固相. 处 一个修正了每个图像的偏移,而分支 B 取消了平滑的空间
背景情况。 全球分支抓取全段的变换,但不能本地化,所以被排除在外
从像素度量;像素评分平均值直接取出8个剩余地图.

blocks.en:
The pointwise predictor cannot model cross-token information flow; its residual emphasises local
mismatch, consistent with the strength on scratches and texture. Dinomaly2 reconstructs layer groups
and is stronger in dense pixel ranking, whereas our score is stronger on image/object decisions.
The two methods are complementary; a coarse-to-fine combination remains untested. The
training-only foreground prior is gated and disabled when unreliable.
blocks.zh:
指针预测器不能建模相接信息流;其剩余强调为局部
与划痕和纹理上的强度一致。 Dinomaly2 重建地层组
在密集像素排名上更强, 而我们的分数在图像/对象决定上更强。
这两种方法是相辅相成的;粗细的组合仍未经过试验。 这个
培训前仅设前台,不可靠时关闭。

blocks.en:
The main comparison uses direct square resizing. Its statistical limits remain: models are trained
independently per category, and main results are deterministic single runs, so we do not interpret
sub-percentage-point differences as stable category rankings.
The supplement reports category dispersion, but training-seed variance, calibration-budget
sensitivity and full cross-category training remain unestimated; the evidence therefore supports a
mechanism-level gain from the fixed channel set, rather than universal per-class superiority or a
claim that the calibration budgets are optimal.
blocks.zh:
主要比较采用直接正方形再大小. 其统计限度仍然存在:模型得到培训
每个类别,主要结果都是决定性的单行, 所以我们不解释
作为稳定的类别排名的分百分点差异。
补编报告了分散类别,但培训种子差异、校正-预算
敏感性和全面跨类别培训仍未估算;因此,证据支持a
从固定信道集获得的机制级收益,而不是普遍/每类优越性或
声称校准预算是最佳的。

blocks.en:
Single-class scope and multi-category extension. We retain one model per category because the
benchmark defines a separate one-class normal support for each category and because the high-pass
strength, branch normalisation and foreground prior are estimated from category-specific normal
images; pooling categories without explicit conditioning would mix several normal manifolds, so a
change that is nominal for one object could become anomalous for another. Multi-category anomaly
detectors are therefore complementary [ 38 , 15 , 17 , 19 , 40 ] , but evaluating them requires a different protocol. The present choice
also exposes the main extension cost: adding a new single category requires training its eight
predictors and recalibrating the three category-specific statistics. A useful next test is a shared
predictor with category-conditioned calibration or lightweight mixture-of-experts heads, evaluated
on held-out-category and object-level protocols; full multi-category training and unseen-category
transfer remain outside the scope of this paper.
blocks.zh:
单等范围和多类延伸. 我们每个类别保留一个模型,因为

blocks.en:
Adjacent-layer cosine similarity reveals stable depth segments. Using deep and shallow blocks as
sources and segment boundaries or midpoints as targets turns cross-layer transfer failure into an
